author: Madrang
install_msg: Installed SdrTools from [RedCogs repository](https://github.com/madrang/RedCogs). Load the cog and request a spectrum picture with `[p]spectrum 96.9`
name: SdrTools
short: RTL-SDR tools: post pictures of the RF spectrum.
description: Captures the RF spectrum around a frequency with an RTL-SDR device on the bot host and replies with a rendered picture.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
